```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: fig-Hypergeometric_Distribution
#| fig-cap: Hypergeometric distribution.
# Packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Data
params <- list(
  list(m = 5, n = 10, k = 3, label = "m=5, n=10, k=3"),
  list(m = 3, n = 7, k = 2, label = "m=3, n=7, k=2"),
  list(m = 2, n = 5, k = 1, label = "m=2, n=5, k=1")
)

plot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(params, function(p) {
  x <- 0:p$k
  data.frame(
    x = x,
    pmf = dhyper(x, m = p$m, n = p$n, k = p$k),
    Parameters = p$label
  )
}))

# Plot
ggplot2::ggplot(plot_data, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = pmf, fill = Parameters)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  ggplot2::ylab("Probability") +
  ggplot2::xlab("x") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
